found.name: Artificial Intelligence Literacy tutorial
found.quote: the examiner will recommend the student to complete an on-line Know How academic integrity tutorial and, if appropriate, an Artificial Intelligence Literacy tutorial;

found.name: Guild of Students Advice Centre
found.quote: The Guild of Students Advice Centre (Liverpool Guild) has trained advisors who can provide this support and students are encouraged to use them.

found.name: Advice and Guidance Team
found.quote: The student will also be provided with contact details of the University’s Advice and Guidance Team so they know how to access wellbeing support should they feel they need it.
